about_the_game:
Features:

  • Go on wild expeditions – Take on weird and hilarious quests, from sewer diving to train heists.

  • Build your treehouse base – Expand and decorate the treehouse with new rooms, furniture and crazy collectibles

  • Chaotic co-op fun – Play solo or with up to 4 friends. Climb, race, and explore together in open-ended missions and wild mini-games.

  • Customize your raccoon – Unlock hats, accessories, and give your raccoon a name and look that fits your style.

Wild expeditions with unexpected rewards

Chase a train, clean up a park, or dig through the junkyard for lost loot. Every mission brings surprises, goofy challenges, and new things to unlock — from tools and areas to cosmetic gear for your raccoon crew.

Climb, jump, and explore like only a raccoon can

Trash piles, trees, rooftops — everything’s a platform. Discover hidden paths and silly secrets in levels built for climbing and messing around.

Play with friends in co-op mini-games

Invite your pals and dive into quick, chaotic fun. From raccoon soccer to trash truck races, there’s always something silly to do in these bite-sized games.

Customize your raccoon

Pick a hat. Or ten. Mix and match outfits, colors, and accessories to give your raccoon some serious (or ridiculous) style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-4160 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Join a mischievous raccoon team on their crazy adventures! Help them expand their HQ and compete with other players in chaotic battles for snacks.
